brief:
Part: cantilever bracket, load at the tip. Solid rectangular cross-section, width across the load, thickness in the load direction.
Load 600 N at the tip, length 150 mm.
REQ-001 yield margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.25 (MS = allowable / (factor x stress) - 1).
REQ-002 ultimate margin of safety >= 0 with factor 1.4.
REQ-003 tip deflection <= 1.5 mm.
REQ-004 width 20-80 mm, thickness 3-8 mm.
REQ-005 thickness must be a stock plate thickness: [3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30] mm.
REQ-006 REQ-001 to REQ-003 must still hold with the load 10% higher and the plate 0.5 mm thinner.
REQ-007 thickness / width <= 2 (a proxy for lateral stability).

summary: Steel 4130 space bracket (69 x 8 mm) passes all six structural and verification rules (S-01 to S-06) and the buy-to-fly, plate availability and thickness tolerance checks (F-01 to F-03), but four actions remain open: replacing typical handbook values with MMPDS allowables (M-01), corrosion finish (M-04), dissimilar-metal fastener specification (M-05), and fracture control classification (X-01). Fatigue (X-02), specialty metals, traceability, supplier quality and export control (P-01 to P-04) are also unresolved, so the bracket is not yet release-ready.
top_risks: Design allowables are still typical handbook values (M-01, action), so the passing margins S-01 to S-03 cannot be trusted for certification until MMPDS A- or B-basis values are applied.
Fatigue and fracture are not analyzed (X-02, X-01); launch vibration cyclic loads and a fracture-control classification are needed, and S-06 is only a t/w proxy, not a buckling analysis.
Unprotected 4130 will rust, and dissimilar-metal joints risk galvanic corrosion (M-04, M-05), while the specialty-metal origin (P-01) and AS9100 supplier requirement (P-03) could block procurement.

actions.action: Replace typical handbook values with MMPDS A- or B-basis allowables for 4130, the specified temper, and the 8 mm thickness, then rerun S-01 to S-03.
Define cyclic load cases (launch vibration and quasi-static) and run a fatigue analysis on the bracket.
Classify the part (e.g., non-fracture-critical) and record the rationale in the fracture control documentation.
Specify a corrosion protection finish per the program finish spec (plating or primer plus paint) and add it to the drawing.
Select fastener material and finish compatible with 4130 per MIL-STD-889 and call them out on the joint drawing.

memo: Recommendation: Award the order for 10 Steel 4130 brackets to Vendor B (sample), which scored highest under the weighting of price at 0.6 and lead time at 0.4. Vendor B offered the lower unit price at $104.48 each with a 13-day lead time, and it is bid-eligible with no compliance issues flagged. Vendor A (sample) was eligible but was not chosen because its unit price of $134.07 and 18-day lead time both trailed Vendor B's, while Vendors C and D were excluded because they submitted no bid and were ineligible, for lacking an AS9100 quality system and for being unable to certify a DFARS-compliant melt source, respectively.
